slots.label: Test synthesiser
slots.note: Synthesises multi-search results in the admin test arena.

slots.label: AgentMail extractor
slots.note: Extracts people, facts and multiple actions from AgentMail messages.

slots.label: Consigliere brief
slots.note: Writes the plain-English daily brief at the top of the Consigliere report — translates the escalations into what needs you / handled / watching, with a recommended fix per problem. This is the voice Douglas reads each day; use a strong model.

slots.label: CRM intent parser
slots.note: Runs when you save a CRM note.

slots.label: Email classifier
slots.note: Runs on Gmail ingestion.

slots.label: Hub dev constraint
slots.note: Knowledge-first development constraint for Hub coding and prompt work.

slots.label: Meeting intake
slots.note: Extracts summaries, attendees, CRM updates, actions, project notes and open questions from meeting transcripts.

slots.label: Opportunity signal extractor
slots.note: Extracts short-lived offers and opportunity signals from inbound emails.

slots.label: Prompt adapter
slots.note: Builds structured reusable prompts from rough prompts and saved examples.

slots.label: Prompt improver
slots.note: Rewrites prompts in the admin test panel.

slots.label: Prompt optimizer
slots.note: Optimises recurring prompt assets against examples and a scored rubric.

slots.label: Prompt shaper
slots.note: Restyles a system prompt to match the conventions of the model family it runs on ("Shape for model" button). Needs a strong model — weak ones copy profile content into the prompt.

slots.label: Regulatory synopsis
slots.note: Assesses regulatory publications for Nakai-only email alerts.

slots.label: Remediation advisor
slots.note: When a family health check fails with no deterministic fix, this model picks a reversible action from the remediation whitelist or declines and escalates to the consigliere. Cheap model is fine — it chooses from a menu, it does not write.

slots.label: Self-repair coding agent
slots.note: The model Pi runs on inside the Mac-mini repair venue when writing bounded fixes for narrow errors. Isolated git worktree, $2/attempt cost cap, human-reviewed via GitHub PR before any deploy. Use a strong coding model.

slots.label: Self-repair triage reviewer
slots.note: Sanity-checks fixable-narrow verdicts in the Mac-mini repair venue. Can only confirm a verdict or downgrade it to config-fix/escalate — never widens the venue's reach. Cheap model is fine.

slots.label: Style profile distiller
slots.note: Monthly job — distils per-model-family prompt style profiles from production system prompts (system_prompts_leaks repo).

slots.label: Task extractor
slots.note: Extracts follow-up tasks from documents and learns from rejected task suggestions.

slots.label: Task rule learner
slots.note: Generalises a wrongly created task into a reusable decision rule. Prompt only — runs on the Task extractor model.

slots.label: Multi-search planner
slots.note: Plans search queries for orchestrated research.

slots.label: Multi-search synthesiser
slots.note: Writes the final report from gathered sources.

slots.label: Recall tagger
slots.note: Fires silently after every chat turn — prefer cheapest available.

slots.label: Action projection
slots.note: Prompt contract for deciding whether source-backed candidate actions should become tasks or reminders.

slots.label: Duplicate/supersession review
slots.note: Prompt contract for semantic duplicate and supersession decisions before creating parallel CRM knowledge.

slots.label: Source triage
slots.note: First prompt in the CRM operating loop: decides whether a new email, meeting, document, task, or fact deserves synthesis.

slots.label: Knowledge query answerer
slots.note: Answers free-form questions on the /crm/knowledge page using atoms, insight atoms, and semantic search results.

slots.label: Project report writer
slots.note: Generates the CRM Project Report page from project meetings, tasks, emails, documents and knowledge atoms.

slots.label: Weekly digest writer
slots.note: Writes the Sunday weekly digest sections from chats, emails and CRM updates.

slots.label: Work brief — project signals
slots.note: Joins radar/briefing content to recent project evidence. Prompt only — runs on the Work daily brief model.

slots.label: Work brief — yesterday recap
slots.note: Recaps yesterday's emails and meetings in 2-3 sentences. Prompt only — runs on the Work daily brief model.

slots.label: Work brief — today line
slots.note: One-sentence summary of today's calendar. Prompt only — runs on the Work daily brief model.

slots.label: Work daily brief model
slots.note: Model for all Work Daily Brief LLM calls: yesterday recap, today line, project signals.

slots.label: Debrief extractor
slots.note: Extracts CRM facts and actions from the transcript.

slots.label: Debrief interviewer
slots.note: Conducts the end-of-day voice debrief. Must be fast with short outputs.

slots.label: Debrief transcriber (STT)
slots.note: Transcribes each spoken answer via the OpenRouter audio/transcriptions endpoint. Must be a speech-to-text model.

slots.label: Debrief voice (TTS)
slots.note: Speaks the interviewer replies via the OpenRouter audio/speech endpoint. Must be a text-to-speech model.

slots.label: Debrief voice name
slots.note: Voice preset passed to the TTS model (Kokoro British voices: bf_emma, bf_isabella, bm_george, bm_lewis). Prompt only — the text IS the voice name.

slots.label: Atom extractor
slots.note: Nightly synthesis — extracts durable claims (atoms) from raw documents, emails and meetings.

slots.label: Completed task extractor
slots.note: Nightly synthesis — promotes only durable completed tasks into project/contact knowledge atoms.

slots.label: Cross-entity synthesis
slots.note: Nightly synthesis — reads all active atoms and writes insight atoms: patterns, workflow opportunities, connections, and gaps spanning multiple entities.

slots.label: Embeddings model
slots.note: Embeds documents, emails, CRM facts and meetings for semantic retrieval. Must be an OpenRouter embeddings model; query and corpus share one model, so changing it re-indexes over time.

slots.label: Entity linker
slots.note: Nightly synthesis — resolves an extracted atom to the contact/company/project it is about when the name is ambiguous.

slots.label: Interest radar
slots.note: Daily job — joins meeting intakes and calendar to name the work topics Douglas is actively engaged with.

slots.label: Live thread synthesis
slots.note: Knowledge layer — notices recurring ideas across Gmail, meetings, newsletters, RSS, opportunity signals, and atoms without forcing them into CRM buckets.

slots.label: Content research driver
slots.note: Drives the last30days multi-source research engine via native web/X search + tool calling for daily topic suggestions. Must support tool calling. Active on the host that runs Grok (CONTENT_RESEARCH_DRIVER=grok, or Mac worker when VPS uses CONTENT_RESEARCH_DRIVER=mac).

slots.label: Carousel generator
slots.note: Generates carousel slide content from research.

slots.label: Carousel reviewer
slots.note: Reviews generated carousel JSON against the content rubric.

slots.label: Post drafter
slots.note: Writes the initial teaser post.

slots.label: Image prompt writer
slots.note: Writes the prompt used for image generation.

slots.label: Query planner
slots.note: Generates search queries for a LinkedIn topic.

slots.label: Draft refiner
slots.note: Makes targeted improvements to the teaser post.

slots.label: Post scorer
slots.note: Evaluates and scores the draft against the rubric.

slots.label: Research synthesiser
slots.note: Writes a research briefing from gathered sources.

slots.label: Display title writer
slots.note: Derives a clean public display title when a post is published — used on llms.txt, the knowledge bundle, and portfolio chat context. Editable per post in the content tool.

slots.label: Challenging — carousel
slots.note: Appended to the carousel prompt when Challenging tone is selected.

slots.label: Challenging — post drafter
slots.note: Appended to the drafter prompt when Challenging tone is selected. Edit to adjust how direct/judgmental the post voice is.

slots.label: Challenging — draft refiner
slots.note: Appended to the refiner prompt when Challenging tone is selected.

slots.label: Provocative — carousel
slots.note: Appended to the carousel prompt when Provocative tone is selected.

slots.label: Provocative — post drafter
slots.note: Appended to the drafter prompt when Provocative tone is selected. Edit to adjust boldness and hot-take framing.

slots.label: Provocative — draft refiner
slots.note: Appended to the refiner prompt when Provocative tone is selected.

slots.label: Nakai daily briefing
slots.note: Writes the daily PDF briefing for Nakai from regulator, government, financial press, and Block product source packs.

slots.label: Reference source extractor
slots.note: Extracts substantive regulatory content from reference-source webpages for the audit-horizon knowledge base.

slots.label: Reference source synthesiser
slots.note: Compiles extracted reference-source content into audit-horizon atoms used by the daily briefing.

slots.label: Briefing writer
slots.note: Writes the weekly intelligence briefing from selected topics.

slots.label: Topic extractor
slots.note: Extracts structured topics from newsletter emails. Runs on every newsletter received.

slots.label: JD analyser
slots.note: Public-facing JD analyser — anyone can trigger. Prefer fast, cheap models.

slots.label: "Ask me" chat
slots.note: Public-facing portfolio chat — anyone can trigger. Prefer fast, cheap models.

slots.label: Salience search planner
slots.note: Plans semantic-search queries to investigate whether signals matter. Prompt only — runs on the Suggestion engine model.

slots.label: Content suggester
slots.note: Suggests LinkedIn post topics from recent RSS/newsletter signals. Prompt only — runs on the Suggestion engine model.

slots.label: Opportunity salience synthesiser
slots.note: Decides whether opportunity signals are worth surfacing given retrieved context. Prompt only — runs on the Suggestion engine model.

slots.label: Travel suggester
slots.note: Spots planned-but-unbooked travel and advises on booking timing. Prompt only — runs on the Suggestion engine model.

slots.label: Suggestion engine model
slots.note: Model for all suggestion-engine calls: travel, content, salience planning and synthesis, price extraction.

slots.label: Travel price extractor
slots.note: Extracts flight prices from Skyscanner alert emails. Prompt only — runs on the Suggestion engine model.

slots.label: Image vision
slots.note: Describes uploaded images before converting them to wiki pages. Cheap vision model recommended.

slots.label: Page writer
slots.note: Converts documents and Q&A into structured wiki pages.

slots.label: Narrative writer
slots.note: Converts a workday voice transcript into a structured Markdown note.

slots.label: AI humanizer
slots.note: Redrafts AI-generated prose to remove machine-writing tells at two layers: six surface tells (rule of three, burstiness, transitions, tone, vocabulary, depth) and six discourse tells (over-explanation, moralising, emotion naming, sensory density, presentation order, audience address). Prompt placeholders [FIELD], [AGGRESSIVENESS] and [SOURCE_TEXT] must be kept. Keep the JSON schema (changes[] need a "layer" field; keep added_data_markers and added_source_markers) or the UI report breaks. Never let it invent facts, figures, or sources.
